explain.revenue: Everything customers paid us in this period.
explain.gross: Revenue minus what the products cost us.
explain.grossMargin: Of every €1 we sell, how much is left after product costs. Our minimum is 50%.
explain.net: What’s left after product costs and all other expenses.
explain.netMargin: Net profit as a share of revenue. Our goal needs at least 50%.
explain.cash: Cash that should be in the cash box: cash sales minus cash expenses (all time).
explain.aov: Revenue divided by the number of sales.
explain.orders: How many sales were logged (reversals not counted).
explain.wow: Revenue of the last 7 days compared with the 7 days before.
explain.perMember: Revenue in this period divided by active team members.
explain.vsBudget: All expenses in this period compared with the total budget of our projects.
explain.costToWin: Marketing expenses divided by customers marked “won” in the Customer pipeline.
explain.breakEven: How much more revenue we need this month so gross profit covers this month’s expenses.
explain.cogs: What the products we sold cost us.
explain.expenses: Everything else we paid for: marketing, transport, printing…
